tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page and section background. Black is the default theme; never tint it, the sky and haze carry the colour.

tokens.name: t1
tokens.usage: Primary text: headlines, row names, prompt text, header handle. On `bg` in both themes (21:1 / 16.8:1).

tokens.name: t2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: sub lines, lead paragraphs, footer copy. On `bg` (10.6:1 / 10:1).

tokens.name: t3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: fine print, prompt labels, neutral row status, meter labels. On `bg` (6.5:1 / 5.1:1). Never below 15px on the web.

tokens.name: sec
tokens.usage: The muted second line of a two-line headline. On `bg`: 5.8:1 on Black, 3.6:1 on White, so on White use it only for headline sizes (24px and up).

tokens.name: div
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers: row rules, the prompt-block top rule, steps track. Decorative only, never the only signal.

tokens.name: sig
tokens.usage: Signature blue fill: CTA capsule, planet button, checked step dots. Text on it is `on-sig`.

tokens.name: sig-text
tokens.usage: Signature blue as text and marks: kickers, yes/free row status, [fill-ins], result lines, links, focus ring, constellation. On `bg` (7:1 / 5.6:1).

tokens.name: on-sig
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `sig` fill (4.7:1).

tokens.name: star
tokens.usage: Faint sky dots and unvisited constellation points (used at 0.45 opacity).

tokens.name: dot-on
tokens.usage: The current constellation point's core.

tokens.name: webb-core
tokens.usage: Centre of the Webb six-spike star in the header mark.

tokens.name: star-cool
tokens.usage: Sky star tint 0 (blue-white). Also the soft glow behind bright stars.

tokens.name: star-white
tokens.usage: Sky star tint 1 (white) and Webb spike stars.

tokens.name: star-warm
tokens.usage: Sky star tint 2 (warm). About 18% of stars.

tokens.name: planet-hi
tokens.usage: Planet sphere highlight stop (radial gradient at 32% 28%). Avatar and next button only.

tokens.name: planet-1
tokens.usage: Planet sphere stop at 36%.

tokens.name: planet-2
tokens.usage: Planet sphere stop at 62% (equals `sig`).

tokens.name: planet-deep
tokens.usage: Planet sphere rim stop at 100%.

tokens.name: aurora-1
tokens.usage: Aurora palette, start (left/top) stop. Line art, gradient strokes, meter fills and sky haze. mint, blue, violet. Work, focus, productivity, prompt packs, tool lists, checklists.

tokens.name: aurora-2
tokens.usage: Aurora palette, middle stop. Line art, gradient strokes, meter fills and sky haze. Apply through `.pal-aurora`, never one stop alone as text.

tokens.name: aurora-3
tokens.usage: Aurora palette, end (right/bottom) stop. Line art, gradient strokes, meter fills and sky haze. Apply through `.pal-aurora`, never one stop alone as text.

tokens.name: orchid-1
tokens.usage: Orchid palette, start (left/top) stop. Line art, gradient strokes, meter fills and sky haze. sky, periwinkle, orchid. Personal, creative, assistants, how-tos, FAQs.

tokens.name: orchid-2
tokens.usage: Orchid palette, middle stop. Line art, gradient strokes, meter fills and sky haze. Apply through `.pal-orchid`, never one stop alone as text.

tokens.name: orchid-3
tokens.usage: Orchid palette, end (right/bottom) stop. Line art, gradient strokes, meter fills and sky haze. Apply through `.pal-orchid`, never one stop alone as text.

tokens.name: lagoon-1
tokens.usage: Lagoon palette, start (left/top) stop. Line art, gradient strokes, meter fills and sky haze. cyan, blue, indigo. News, speed, tech, top lists, explainers, timelines. The site default.

tokens.name: lagoon-2
tokens.usage: Lagoon palette, middle stop. Line art, gradient strokes, meter fills and sky haze. Apply through `.pal-lagoon`, never one stop alone as text.

tokens.name: lagoon-3
tokens.usage: Lagoon palette, end (right/bottom) stop. Line art, gradient strokes, meter fills and sky haze. Apply through `.pal-lagoon`, never one stop alone as text.

tokens.name: electric-1
tokens.usage: Electric palette, start (left/top) stop. Line art, gradient strokes, meter fills and sky haze. blue, indigo, violet. Models, power, comparisons, launches, numbers.

tokens.name: electric-2
tokens.usage: Electric palette, middle stop. Line art, gradient strokes, meter fills and sky haze. Apply through `.pal-electric`, never one stop alone as text.

tokens.name: electric-3
tokens.usage: Electric palette, end (right/bottom) stop. Line art, gradient strokes, meter fills and sky haze. Apply through `.pal-electric`, never one stop alone as text.

tokens.name: twilight-1
tokens.usage: Twilight palette, start (left/top) stop. Line art, gradient strokes, meter fills and sky haze. blue, lilac, pink. Culture, design, myths, mistakes.

tokens.name: twilight-2
tokens.usage: Twilight palette, middle stop. Line art, gradient strokes, meter fills and sky haze. Apply through `.pal-twilight`, never one stop alone as text.

tokens.name: twilight-3
tokens.usage: Twilight palette, end (right/bottom) stop. Line art, gradient strokes, meter fills and sky haze. Apply through `.pal-twilight`, never one stop alone as text.

tokens.name: hero-mint-top
tokens.usage: Hero finish mint (pairs with aurora), top stop. Only for hero numerals and the one gradient word, via `.hero-mint`; on White the top stop is dark enough for 3:1.

tokens.name: hero-mint-mid
tokens.usage: Hero finish mint (pairs with aurora), mid stop. Only for hero numerals and the one gradient word, via `.hero-mint`; on White the top stop is dark enough for 3:1.

tokens.name: hero-mint-deep

styles.name: hero-xl
styles.usage: Cover count, 1 to 2 digits, in a hero finish. Mobile: clamp(140px, 38vw, 240px).

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: Rank ("03"), year or a word of 4 characters or fewer, in a hero finish. Mobile: clamp(96px, 26vw, 160px).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page hero headline, two lines max, ends with "." or "?". Mobile: clamp(48px, 11vw, 96px).

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Section headline, one idea per section. Mobile: clamp(40px, 8.5vw, 64px).

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Item names, card titles, flip myths. Mobile: 32px.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: AI news, tech, prompts and links to skills. In your inbox every week.
styles.usage: Sub line under a headline, in `t2`, text-wrap balance, max 34em. Mobile: 20px.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Tokens are chunks of text. A model reads and writes them one at a time.
styles.usage: Running text in `t2` (or `t1` for long reads), max 65 characters a line.

styles.name: prompt
styles.sample: “Reply to this email in three short lines. Keep [the tone].”
styles.usage: Copy-ready prompt text in `t1`, curly quotes, [fill-ins] in `sig-text` 600.

styles.name: row-name
styles.usage: Row name, left, in `t1`.

styles.name: result
styles.usage: Result line and yes/free row status in `sig-text`; neutral status in `t3`.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Eyebrow above a headline in `sig-text`, sentence case, parts joined with " · ".

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Header handle, header label, footer teaser, button labels at small size, in `t1`.

styles.name: fine
styles.sample: On paid plans. Prices per 1M tokens.
styles.usage: Qualifiers, where-to-find-it lines and captions in `t3`. The floor: nothing smaller.

styles.name: frame-hero-cover
styles.usage: Carousel and reel cover count on the 1080 canvas, 1 character.

styles.name: frame-hero
styles.usage: Rank, year or short word on the 1080 canvas, 4 characters or fewer.

styles.name: frame-headline
styles.usage: Frame headline, 92 to 120px (about 14 characters a line at 104).

styles.name: frame-kicker
styles.usage: Frame kicker in `sig-text`.

styles.name: frame-sub
styles.sample: Close to Opus at half the price.
styles.usage: Frame sub line in `t2`, 3 lines max.

styles.name: frame-prompt
styles.usage: Frame prompt text, 4 lines max.

styles.name: frame-row
styles.usage: Frame row name; status beside it is 30px 600.

styles.name: frame-fine
styles.usage: Frame fine print in `t3`.

styles.name: frame-meta
styles.usage: Frame header and footer text. The 24px floor of the frame system.

spacing.note: The frame grid is 1080 wide with 80px margins (a 920px measure). The web scale keeps those numbers and adds steps between.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Optical nudges (hero top margin, icon offsets).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside tiny clusters.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between the Webb mark and the header label.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between avatar and handle, teaser and planet button; minimum page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Row gap between name and status; sub-line top margin on the web.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Prompt-block padding above its text; gap between headline and sub on the web.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Space above a prompt block or a CTA capsule.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked blocks inside one section.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: The frame margin. Desktop page gutter and header/footer inset.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop (top and bottom).

tokens.name: space-11
tokens.usage: Section padding for hero and CTA sections.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Content measure: the 1080 frame minus its 80px margins. Max width for headlines and rows.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the content column, gutters included.

tokens.name: header-h
tokens.usage: Header bar height (planet avatar wrap is 60px).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Meter track, small capsules, bar art.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inner chip core, small glass tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Glass panels and document art (condense, cards at 24 to 30).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Large glass cards, the chip body.

tokens.name: radius-bubble
tokens.usage: Chat bubbles.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: CTA capsule, tags, every pill. Circles use 50%.

shadow.note: Light, never darkness: every shadow is a coloured glow. No drop shadows, no dark halos behind text.

tokens.name: glow-sig
tokens.usage: Resting glow on the CTA capsule.

tokens.name: glow-sig-peak
tokens.usage: CTA pulse peak (reel loop end) and hover.

tokens.name: glow-planet
tokens.usage: Planet avatar and planet button sphere.

tokens.name: glow-cursor
tokens.usage: The blue typing cursor on a hook.

tokens.name: glow-fill
tokens.usage: Meter fill and timeline progress line.

tokens.name: glow-strike
tokens.usage: Myth strike-through bar.

stroke.note: Line-art weights from art.py v2. Round caps and joins everywhere.

tokens.name: stroke-primary
tokens.usage: The one primary stroke of every glass icon.

tokens.name: stroke-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary strokes, step dots and back cards.

tokens.name: stroke-orbit
tokens.usage: Orbit rings and dashed paths.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers and the avatar orbit (1.25px).

duration.note: From the reel engine. CSS cannot hold the easing curves here; see easing.

tokens.name: dur-stagger
tokens.usage: Delay between words rising into a headline (100ms for a hook).

tokens.name: dur-fade
tokens.usage: Sub lines, rows and kickers fading up.

tokens.name: dur-word
tokens.usage: One word sliding up out of its mask; exits.

tokens.name: dur-push
tokens.usage: Push-through on a hero numeral, name flying into a row, the spine rising.

tokens.name: dur-draw
tokens.usage: Glass line art drawing its strokes in.

tokens.name: dur-count
tokens.usage: A stat counting up to its final value.

tokens.name: dur-hold-min
tokens.usage: Shortest time any beat stays readable (reel holds = reveal + words at 5 per second).

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Entrances: words, rows, fades (cubic out).

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Exits, push-throughs, flights and camera glides (cubic in-out).

tokens.name: ease-back
tokens.usage: The hero numeral settling and the CTA capsule popping in (a small overshoot).
